svg.title: Exploratory map: what changes the effect of multiplying every number by a million
svg.desc: Forest plot. Rows are exploratory cells grouped by question (zone shape and notation, instructions, information, a redesigned game, mixed pairs); columns are the model as seller and as buyer against a scale-proof bot (change in its own share) and self-play (change in the seller's share); Gemma 4 31B and Qwen points with 95% intervals.
svg.text: change in the model's own share
change in the model's own share
“the size of the numbers doesn't matter”
← worse for the model at ×10⁶ (a, b) / for the seller (c)
Points: mean ×10⁶ − ×1 change per fixture, bars: 95% CI; fresh fixtures, n = 30 unless marked. All exploratory.
The bot's moves are ratios of its own limit, so at ×10⁶ they are its ×1 moves with six zeros appended.
Squares in (c): mixed pairs, coloured by the seller's model.
X17 (redesigned game) excludes the games with a comma slip in a price (n = 28).
